title: Transcribe DNA into RNA
summary: A biology utility transcribes a DNA strand into its complementary RNA sequence. Map each supported nucleotide according to the transcription table and preserve sequence length. Map each DNA nucleotide to its complementary RNA nucleotide.
requirements: Throw an Error containing Invalid DNA nucleotide for any invalid character.
hints: Use a lookup table for substitutions.
Validate each character before appending its complement.
